termination_acceptance_statistic.definition: max(pooled one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper, one-sided seed-group t upper); pooled only across seed groups
termination_acceptance_statistic.granularity: per shape (monte carlo), per (h, shape) (h sweep)
termination_acceptance_statistic.aggregation: worst shape controls; never pooled across shapes or h
termination_acceptance_statistic.note: Reported alongside the legacy row-wise point-estimate gate. Neither term alone is safe: pooled Clopper-Pearson assumes exchangeable replicas, and the seed-group t bound carries no within-group binomial uncertainty.

monte_carlo_termination_acceptance.statistic: max(pooled_clopper_pearson_upper, seed_group_t_upper), one-sided, pooled only across seed groups
